definitions.gloss: small fish; small fry (used as food)
definitions.explanation: Small fish such as anchovies, sardines, and whitebait, often eaten whole and prized for their calcium content. Also a general term for any small fish.

examples.japanese: {小魚|こざかな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
{小魚|こざかな}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{骨|ほね}→骨：02166_hone⟧ごと⟦{食|た}べられて→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Small fish can be eaten bones and all, and are nutritious.

examples.japanese: ⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{浅瀬|あさせ}→浅瀬：15720_asase⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{小魚|こざかな}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{群|む}れ→群れ：00298_mure⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きらきら→きらきら：05159_kirakira⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{泳|およ}いでいた→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧。
examples.english: A school of small fish was swimming and glinting in the shallows of the river.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{小|こ}→小〜：00240_ko⟧ (small) + ⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧, with rendaku turning さかな into ざかな. Often refers to small dried fish (⟦おやつ→おやつ：17921_oyatsu⟧ or topping) but also any small live fish.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {小魚|こざかな}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{群|む}れ→群れ：00298_mure⟧: a school of small fish
- {小魚|こざかな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{釣|つ}る→釣る：01236_tsuru⟧: to catch small fish
- ⟦カルシウム→カルシウム：10963_karushiumu⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧な{小魚|こざかな}: calcium-rich small fish
- ⟦アーモンド→アーモンド：10714_aamondo⟧{入|い}り{小魚|こざかな}: small fish snack with almonds

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {雑魚|ざこ}: small fish (collectively); also figurative "small fry" — more colloquial; can be derogatory of people
- しらす: whitebait — specifically tiny young sardines/anchovies
- {大魚|たいぎょ}: large fish — antonym
